name: Felt
description: Felt is a collaborative web mapping and GIS platform for creating, sharing and analyzing interactive maps and geospatial data.

events.d: Get a map with its details, layers and annotations.
Copy a map with all its layers and annotations into a project or folder.
Create a new Felt map with a title, start location, basemap and sharing level.
Update a map title, description, basemap, sharing level or viewer permissions.
Move a map to another project or folder in the workspace.
Permanently delete a map and all its layers, annotations and comments.
Create a project to organize maps, shared with the workspace or kept private.
Add a new data layer to a map from a public URL of geodata.
Draw a point, line or polygon annotation on a map, or update an existing one.
Refresh a URL-based layer so it pulls the latest data from its source.
Runs when a new map is created in a selected project.

recipes.ae: List a record by Record ID
